outcome_levels.L0: INCONCLUSIVE — criteria cannot be applied (undated, partial coverage, missing measurements).
outcome_levels.L1: TYPE — a feature of the predicted type exists at the site in the period (already known for several entries; counts only if newly observed).
outcome_levels.L2: FEATURE — the predicted feature with all reading-specific constraints (orientation, relative position, distance) is observed and dated; rival features listed.
outcome_levels.L3: SPOT — at the predicted spot/depth window a cut, cavity or disturbance of the period is documented (an empty or refilled cavity is consistent with ancient retrieval).
outcome_levels.L4: DEPOSIT — a deposit of the kind the entry lists is found at the spot.
outcome_levels.MISS: The record's MISS criterion is met (scope stated in the record: feature-level or target-level).

records.branch: Achor = Wadi Nuweiʿimeh; ruin = Ḥoreibbeh near later Chorembe monastery
records.reading_assumed: ḥryb(ʾ)h 'little ruin' (yod) read as the place Ḥoreibbeh; עכור = Achor; 40 cubits (unit word after 'cubits', Puech)
records.reading_status: disputed (waw/yod in the ruin word; עכור vs עבור 'go past'; 40 vs 41 vs deleted word)
records.site_name: Wadi Nuweiʿimeh (valley), NE of Jericho
records.anchor_note: Gazetteer anchor for the site/area (shared/places.json), NOT the predicted feature's position.
records.feature_type: ruin with a stair that 'goes in toward the east'
records.feature_detail: A ruined building (already a ruin, or later known as Ḥoreibbeh/Chorembe) with a built or rock-cut flight of steps whose line of entry runs eastward.
records.period_requirement: Feature must be shown to exist (built, or standing as an accessible ruin) at some time within c. 50 BCE–70 CE (the repo's criterion 'in use 1st c. BCE–70 CE'); an extended window to 135 CE is allowed to cover the Bar Kokhba-era dating reported for Gibson 2025/26. A feature whose earliest construction is securely later than 135 CE is a period MISS for that feature.
records.orientation_constraint: stair axis runs (enters) toward the east; tolerance not stated by the text — score with ±45° of true east and report the measured azimuth

measures.type: distance along/under the stair (unresolved: distance vs depth)

records.location_constraint: Within the Wadi Nuweiʿimeh drainage NE/N of Jericho; Milik and Puech tie the ruin name to the monastery of Chorembe near Kh. el-Mafjar (no gazetteer coordinate for that monastery; none asserted here).
records.confirm: L2: a ruin with an east-running stair, standing or built before 135 CE (preferably before 70 CE), documented in the valley near the Chorembe/Kh. el-Mafjar area. L3: a period cut/cavity 17.8–21.0 m (40 c.; 18.2–21.5 m for 41 c.) from the stair head or foot along its axis.
records.miss: Feature-level only: for a specific candidate ruin, the stair is securely dated after 135 CE with no earlier phase, or the 17.8–21.5 m axial band beyond both stair ends is excavated to sterile deposits/bedrock without any period cut. No area-level miss can follow from one excavation.
records.inconclusive: Undated stair; azimuth not recorded; band only partly excavated; ruin of uncertain identity with Chorembe.
records.deposit_expected: As listed in the entry text (entry_text_en_project); used only for L4.
